writing.explanation: Monotonic Decreasing Stack belongs to Stack, Queue & Monotonic Patterns. Its invariant is the part that stays true after every step; tracing that invariant is more reliable than memorising lines. Typical uses include stock span, next greater, visibility.
writing.feedback: The invariant explains both correctness and which state may change.
